Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood has been tapped as the brokerage and initial trustee for Trump Accounts, and is working alongside BNY and The U.S. Department of Treasury to develop and operate the program, which aims to expand market access for the next generation of Americans. In this role, you will help build a world-class, intuitive platform, leveraging Robinhood’s industry-leading financial technology to deliver a standalone web and app experience for this historic national initiative.

The Government Products team focuses on building and scaling systems that support long-term investing and account management for millions of customers. This team works closely with product, data, and infrastructure partners to deliver reliable, secure, and intuitive  experiences. You will help shape systems that enable customers to plan for their financial future with confidence!

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build large-scale distributed systems that support real-time trading, balances, and platform capabilities. You will lead technically complex projects, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with frontend and data partners to deliver well-structured APIs. Your work will directly influence system performance, operational safety, and long-term maintainability across core Robinhood products.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with hybrid attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve scalable backend systems, balancing performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Design, implement, test, and release product-facing features with strict correctness and availability requirements.

  • Partner with frontend and data engineers to define and refine REST APIs that serve millions of customers.

  • Lead large, technically complex projects from design through execution.

  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on technical guidance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, developer productivity, and operational risk.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.

  • 3+ years of experience building low-latency, large-scale distributed systems in production environments.

  • Experience designing and operating highly concurrent systems and well-structured REST APIs.

  • Demonstrated ownership of large projects with sustained impact on a system or team.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to prioritize work aligned with business and reliability goals.

  • Ability to break down complex problems and deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

  • Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to technical direction on new initiatives.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

Position Restriction: This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Capital markets are undergoing a fundamental shift. Assets that live in fragmented systems and manual workflows are moving onto blockchains -systems designed to move and store value more transparently and efficiently.

While this unlocks more open and programmable financial systems, it also introduces significant complexity. For most users, interacting with this new infrastructure is still too difficult.

Fun builds the infrastructure that powers consumer-facing fintech applications - handling onboarding, account access, and money movement so users can interact with blockchain-based systems as seamlessly as they do with traditional finance.

For fintech builders, Fun provides a best-in-class onboarding and deposit stack that drives conversion and unlocks user growth. We operate at the intersection of financial infrastructure, complex engineering, and product experience.
 
 

About the Role

Our Security Lead covers application, cloud and AI security. We're hiring a Senior Corporate Security Engineer to own everything else that keeps Fun safe day to day: the identities, laptops, SaaS tools and vendors every employee and contractor depends on. Some companies call this enterprise security; whatever the name, it's the place where IT and security meet.

You'll be our first dedicated hire in this area, so you'll set the baseline as well as maintain it. We want someone who treats corporate security as an engineering problem. That means configuration in code, access granted by automation instead of by hand, and controls strong enough that a breached vendor or a phished employee is an inconvenience, not an incident.

What you'll own:

    Identity and access

  • Run SSO, MFA and automated provisioning (SCIM) across Google Workspace and the rest of our stack
  • Build joiner/mover/leaver flows so new hires have the right access on day one and departing people lose it within minutes
  • Run regular access reviews and keep admin and privileged access to a minimum

    • Endpoints

  • Define and enforce macOS baselines through MDM: disk encryption, EDR, OS updates, device compliance
  • Tie device health to access so an unmanaged or out-of-date laptop can't reach sensitive systems
  • Address the new risks of AI agents and coding assistants running on employee machines, including what they can read, where data goes and what they're allowed to run

    • SaaS security

  • Harden Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, our CRM and the rest of the stack: least privilege, external sharing and guest controls, and data protection guardrails
  • Find and reduce shadow IT, and keep seats and licenses tight

    • Vendors and third parties

  • Run security reviews for new vendors and integrations, and maintain a tiered inventory of the ones we can't operate without
  • Plan in advance for when a critical vendor is breached or goes down, so we're never improvising

    • Detection and response

  • Make sure identity, endpoint and SaaS activity is logged and actionable
  • Own corporate incidents such as phishing, account takeover and lost devices, and take part in company-wide incident response and blameless postmortems

    • Compliance and customer trust

  • Own the corporate and IT controls for SOC 2 and similar frameworks, with evidence collected automatically rather than by screenshot
  • Help answer enterprise customers' security questionnaires and reviews
    •  

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: You know every identity, device and critical SaaS app we run, and where the gaps are
  • 60 days: SSO, MFA and automated offboarding are complete across the core stack, and every laptop is enrolled in MDM with EDR running
  • 90 days: Core identity and SaaS configuration is managed as code, there's a working vendor review process, and the corporate security roadmap for 2027 is written and agreed

You might be a fit if you have:

  • 5+ years in corporate security, enterprise security or security-minded IT engineering, ideally at a fast-growing startup
  • Deep hands-on experience with an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, or Google Workspace as IdP), including SSO, SCIM and conditional access
  • Experience running macOS fleets securely with an MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or similar) and EDR
  • Automation skills: you write Python, Bash or similar against APIs to remove repetitive work
  • Heavy daily use of AI tools like Claude Code, and good judgment about where they help and where they create risk
  • Sound, risk-based judgment, and the ability to explain a tradeoff to an engineer, a salesperson or an executive and leave them agreeing

    •  

Nice to Have:

  • Terraform or other config-as-code for identity, MDM or SaaS
  • Experience at a crypto, fintech or payments company, especially one with real money at stake
  • Having taken a company through SOC 2 or ISO 27001
  • Incident response or SOC background
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics and transaction screening tools (Chainalysis, TRM)
  • Experience supporting a team split across time zones
This role has a base salary range of $140,000 – $200,000, shared in accordance with NYC pay transparency guidelines. We aim to pay top-of-market and benchmark compensation regularly to remain highly competitive within our industry. In addition to base salary, we offer a strong total rewards package that may include equity ownership, performance incentives, and comprehensive benefits. Compensation is tailored by level, with offers based on impact, experience, and skillset, while maintaining internal equity across the team.

Salary: USD 140,000 - USD 200,000 per year

Why Join Us
● Shape the future of payments and programmable money
● Work with bleeding-edge tech in a domain where innovation moves fast
● Join a mission-driven team focused on access, openness, and trust
● Be a key contributor, not just a cog—your work will ship fast and matter
● Collaborate with top-tier protocols, builders, and financial infrastructure providers
 
Location and Work Environment This role is primarily in-person at our Midtown, NYC headquarters. We work together Monday through Thursday for fast, iterative collaboration and optional WFH Fridays to reset and recharge.

Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role 

As the Business Development Partner, Technology, on our GTM Technology Network at a16z, you will build and cultivate direct, high-trust relationships with technical and product leadership (VP/Head of Engineering, Head of AI, CPO/VP Product, etc) at leading digital native and growth technology organizations, including top infrastructure, consumer technology, SaaS, and other important technology sectors. 

In this role, you will play a pivotal role in building credible, trusted relationships with senior leaders by understanding and delivering a meaningful value exchange between a16z and the network. This includes providing access to relevant insights, thought leadership, peer connections, and exposure to innovative companies across our ecosystem. By establishing a16z as a valuable and trusted partner, you will enable high-quality connections with our portfolio companies that support company building and go-to-market efforts over time.

As part of the a16z Go-to-Market team, you will bring your expertise, rolodex, and knowledge of the technology industry market dynamics. You will have an opportunity to advise a16z portfolio companies on how to navigate, partner with, and sell to these organizations. By doing this you will play a crucial role in helping accelerate their go-to-market efforts and time to revenue.

This role requires an in-office presence 3-4 days a week in our Toyko, Japan office. 

To join our team, you should be excited to: 

  • Build and cultivate strategic, positive relationships for the firm with a network of technology decision makers, understanding their business challenges and connecting them to portfolio companies and partners to help them solve these challenges 
  • Develop and continuously refine an approach to building access and trust with key technical leaders, aligned to portfolio company GTM priorities
  • Lead efforts to build these key relationships through creative engagements. This may include hosting dinners, receptions, and industry-focused events to bring together our corporate network, firm, and portfolio
  • Develop long-term relationships with portfolio companies and connect a16z portfolio companies to the technology network through introductions, meetings, corporate briefings, events, and conferences 
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to align on business development initiatives and other firm-wide goals
  • Stay abreast of a16z investment areas, industry trends, portfolio investments, and leverage insights to drive business opportunities 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 15+ years in roles that required building and maintaining relationships with senior technical leaders in the digital native and growth tech companies. This can include business development, sales, ecosystem or related role in a technology company
  • Experience working in or closely with digital native and growth tech companies (infrastructure, AI, data, or SaaS), with exposure to engineering or product leadership
  • Strong understanding of how technology buying decisions are made (top-down and bottom-up), with a track record of building trusted, enduring relationships
  • Working knowledge of modern technology stacks (infrastructure, cloud, AI, data, security) and applications.
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with a focus on detail and executive presence 
  • Ability to discern industry needs and trends, effectively communicating insights to investment partners 
  • Established executive relationships within the technology sector, with a strong ability to independently manage those relationships 
  • Proven ability to self-start, operate autonomously, manage multiple priorities, independently contribute, ability to deal with ambiguity, and execute consistently in a dynamic environment

descriptions.job-10pjjhm:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

This is the first product role DriveWealth has placed in-market, and you will own what it becomes. You are the product voice for our partners in India across the full platform: equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options, plus the account opening and money movement capabilities underneath them. Partners in this market bring requirements that are specific, sometimes ambiguous, and always urgent, and your job is to convert them into scoped, sequenced, shipped work. You will not run a dedicated engineering team. Your leverage comes from judgment, credibility, and your ability to pull the right product owners and engineering leads across the platform onto the right problem. You own the call on which requests become roadmap, which get an alternative solution, and which get a clear no. You will work in close partnership with our regional Head of Sales, and you will represent this function directly to partners and to product leadership. Success in year one looks like partners in India who feel heard, a delivery record they can point to, and a repeatable model we can stand up in the next jurisdiction.

What You’ll Do

  • Become the primary product point of contact for our partners in India, and build the relationships that surface real requirements before they become escalations
  • Translate partner asks across all asset classes, accounts, and money movement into requirements, user stories, and documentation that other product owners and engineering teams can execute against without a translation layer
  • Sequence and track delivery across multiple product domains, holding the through-line from request to launch when no single team owns the whole thing
  • Partner with the regional Head of Sales on commercial context, partner priorities, and competitive pressure in-market
  • Test every request against platform capability and local jurisdictional requirements, and propose the alternative when the answer is no
  • Spot the patterns across requests that point to a platform gap, and drive them into the appropriate domain roadmap yourself
  • Decide when to push back, when to escalate, and when to absorb complexity to keep delivery moving, without needing that judgment checked
  • Speak for this function in partner, sales, and product leadership forums on status, tradeoffs, and constraints
  • Write the playbook for in-market product delivery, with an eye to what should scale to the next jurisdiction

You Bring

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in Financial Services and/or Fintech or equivalent industries, in product management, business analysis, or a senior partner-facing technical role
  • Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent in relevant experience
  • Experience with trading platforms, brokerage, or fintech infrastructure
  • Experience analyzing data using SQL and relevant BI tools
  • FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) completion, or a commitment to acquire within the first year with support from your Manager
  • A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes environments
  • The ability to prioritize ruthlessly, focussing on what’s critical versus important to drive work to completion

Margin calls and collateral

Analytics and reporting

As our Staff Brand Designer, you come to the table with a strong design vision and set the visual standard for Kraken. You design static work for launches, campaigns and always-on activity, and you make sure it looks like one brand wherever someone meets it. You can take a brief or proactive idea to a finished, approved asset set, and you're comfortable building a clean, systemized layout in Figma. If you can also model and render a hero 3D asset in Cinema 4D, that's a real bonus.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and ownership: you set the bar for brand quality on the team, you build systems others can work from, and you're the person colleagues come to with design questions.

What you'll do

  • Design static creative for Kraken across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build scalable systems: Figma component libraries, marketing templates and modular campaign kits with localization-ready layouts, so other designers, other teams and our automated workflows can produce on-brand work quickly.

  • Use AI-assisted production as a core part of how the brand gets made, and know when it speeds the work up and when it doesn't.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Push back with a point of view when a brief is unclear or the idea can be stronger.

  • Strong layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at small sizes and in multiple languages.

About HIFI

HIFI is a stablecoin infrastructure company building technology for the next-generation of financial products. We build tools for payments and tokenized money products across money movement, cards, and capital markets. Institutions and enterprises already use our platform and APIs to move billions of dollars in production environments around the world, and we are still early.

 

Founded in 2022, our organization is flat and our team is talent dense. We work in person at our office in Flatiron and are intentional about who we work with. We've raised $37 million from world-class investors, including a Series A led by Left Lane Capital.

 

About the Team

HIFI's marketing team helps fintechs, banks, and financial institutions understand how stablecoin payments can work for their business and why HIFI is the right infrastructure to build on. The team works closely with sales and product to reach the companies that will benefit most from HIFI, through programs, events, content, and the website. As more institutions begin moving money on stablecoin rails, the team's work determines how many of them start that journey with HIFI.

 

The Marketing Manager leads this work day to day. You'll plan and run the programs that introduce HIFI to new customers, and you'll measure their impact on how our business grows. This is a hands-on role with real ownership: you'll execute programs yourself, manage the marketing budget and tools, and work directly with sales to understand which efforts lead to lasting customer relationships. You'll also help leadership decide where to invest next based on what's working.

 

Responsibilities

  • Plan and run HIFI's marketing programs for fintechs, banks, and financial institutions, from first touch through to a conversation with sales.

  • Own HIFI's presence at industry conferences and events, including selecting which ones to attend, managing logistics, and following up with the companies we meet.

  • Host HIFI's own events, such as customer dinners, roundtables, and webinars, that bring payments and finance leaders together.

  • Manage the website as a channel for new customers, working with design and engineering to improve how visitors find what they need and get in touch.

  • Produce and distribute content that helps prospective customers evaluate stablecoin payments, using the positioning and messaging set by product marketing.

  • Run email and digital programs, and maintain the marketing tools and CRM data that support them.

  • Work with sales to define the customers we want to reach, track how programs contribute to new business, and share what's working with leadership.

  • Manage the marketing budget and outside partners, including agencies and event vendors.

 

You might be a fit if

  • 6+ years of experience in demand generation or growth marketing, ideally at a B2B fintech, payments, infrastructure, or crypto company.

  • You've run programs aimed at sophisticated buyers, such as product, finance, or treasury leaders at fintechs, banks, or enterprises.

  • Experience planning and running events end to end, from industry conferences to small executive dinners.

  • Hands-on experience with marketing and CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce, and comfort working with the data behind them.

  • A track record of measuring how programs contribute to new business, and adjusting where you invest based on the results.

  • Strong writing skills and the ability to turn technical material into content that payments and finance audiences find useful.

  • Working familiarity with stablecoins and payment flows, or a genuine interest in learning them quickly.

  • Experience working closely with sales teams on long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • You're comfortable managing a budget and outside partners, and you prefer doing the work yourself to directing others to do it.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift as the market and the business evolve.

 

Why This Role Matters

Most institutions evaluating stablecoin payments are doing it for the first time, and the companies they hear from early are often the ones they choose. This is a chance to build how HIFI reaches those institutions at the point when the market is forming, and to see your work show up directly in the customers HIFI signs and the business it grows.

Must be within a commutable distance from our office and able to work in person most days of the week.
